$comment: Movie Mafia subjects. The fan clue is specific enough that people who share it converge; the imposter clue is true of the film but vague enough to survive one round of conversation and no longer. If the imposter clue named a different film the bluff would be impossible; if it matched the fan clue there would be no imposter.
